training_width_schedule: paired consecutive steps consume identical 48 input pairs at a single width; 8/16 alternate across blocks
training_pair_assignment: all arms see identical ordered operand pairs in each step; evaluation split is disjoint under unordered operand pair equality
rehearsal: per pair, current operation once and prior operation once over two consecutive steps; shuffled half new and half old in each step
blocked_replay: same EXACT operand-task multiset as rehearsal per pair and width, but all current in even step, all prior in odd step
new_only: same total examples/update count and operand pairs, but only current task assignments; per-task exposure differs intentionally
evaluation_policy: fixed unseen operand pairs across arms and stages; 7 tasks per group, exact-answer and scalar-final-bit scores, independent full trace
old_skill_retention: absolute exact-accuracy change versus baseline and preceding stage per operation/group; report regression counts with >=5 percentage point loss
rehearsal_gain_gate: report per-seed prior-skill score differences vs new_only and blocked_replay at stages 2,3,4; if no consistent matched gain label NO_GAIN
original_model_rule: NO original checkpoint/config/source writes or promotion; only task-local candidates and evidence
scientific_caveats: All seven task names were already present in the pretrained RLT; 'reexposure' is curriculum-relative, not a newly invented task
New generated train/validation disjointness does not establish disjointness from the original pretrained RLT training ledger
Host-provided operation IDs and compositional execution do not establish autonomous program construction
New-only sees equal total updates/examples, but fewer prior-task examples by design
Rehearsal and blocked replay have exactly matched operand-task-width totals, but differ in temporal order and optimization trajectory
Finite samples and 144 updates per arm cannot establish universal learning optimality or AGI
